method: the run folder was copied to a scratch folder; the derived review/packet/inspection files were rebuilt there with the Console-16 code (before) and the Console-17 code (after)

recorded_first_error.detail: Present_Position: RuntimeError: servo response error: ID=6 error=0x20 [RxPacketError] Overload error!

root_cause: replay.ReplaySession.index_faults() gave the lifetime owner_end exception (no failed-stage host time) time_s=0 via stage.get('t_host_s', 0); 0 was then 'earlier' than the real servo error, replaced record.first_error in save_review(), and the failure packet/inspection used 0 as the reference time, so the session's first frames were exported as 'after the failure'
fix: replay.index_faults: an error without a recorded host time keeps time_s=None (time_basis=NOT_RECORDED_FOR_THIS_ERROR), is kept in untimed_errors and is never ordered as the first error

records.save_failure_packet: failure time = failed-stage time, else the timed first error, else CURRENT_FEEDBACK first_error time, else None (UNKNOWN_NOT_RECORDED). The former fallbacks (0 / last event) are removed; nothing is interpolated
records.save_failure_packet: failure_sequence lists the first servo/bus error, the failed stage and the owner_end exception separately, each with its own recorded clock

inspection_window.selection_basis: failure/reference ±3s export only; exact raw samples, no interpolation
